unit.title: More Letters of the Gurmukhi Alphabet

lesson.title: Finishing the Row: ਡ, ਢ, and ਣ
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: You've learned the tongue-curl trick! Today we finish that row with three more letters: ਡ (dadda), ਢ (ddhadha), and ਣ (nana).

ਡ (dadda) and ਢ (ddhadha) use the same tongue-curl as yesterday's ਟ/ਠ, but make a 'd' sound instead — ਢ is the breathier version of ਡ. ਣ (nana) also uses the tongue-curl, but makes an 'n' sound. Practice all five letters from this row together: ta... tha... da... dha... na, feeling your tongue curl back for every single one.
You now know nineteen letters, and you've mastered a whole row that uses the tongue-curl sound! Tomorrow we'll move to a new row that sounds similar but feels different in your mouth.

objectives: Recognize and name the letters ਡ (dadda), ਢ (ddhadha), and ਣ (nana)
Complete the full retroflex (tongue-curl) row: ਟ, ਠ, ਡ, ਢ, ਣ
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review yesterday's ਟ, ਠ and the tongue-curl feeling.
2. Introduce ਡ, ਢ, ਣ, having the child notice the same tongue-curl in each.
3. Practice the full five-letter row together: ta...tha...da...dha...na.
4. Trace each letter in the air before picking up a pencil.
5. Move to the worksheet: trace each letter, then write it once more.
6. Close by counting all nineteen letters and celebrating a complete row.
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just ਡ (the clearest new sound) before adding ਢ's breathier pair and ਣ's different ending sound
Ready for more: ask the child to say the complete five-letter row from memory, without a prompt
This completes a genuinely full row — a good moment to celebrate the accomplishment before moving to new material tomorrow
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a tracing and recognition activity — check that each traced letter roughly matches the shape shown.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: ਡ, ਢ, ਣ complete the retroflex consonant row in the Painti Akhari sequence, giving the child a full, coherent set of tongue-curl sounds before the next row introduces a contrasting articulation. Every letter was validated against gurmukhifix's Lexicon before writing.

worksheet.title: Finishing the Row: ਡ, ਢ, ਣ

generationData.instructions: Trace each letter, say its name out loud, then write it once more on your own.
